Building & Maintaining Systems from the Blocks Up.

I work on building, scaling, and maintaining open source infrastructure and cloud-native systems. With a strong passion for systems engineering, Linux, Kubernetes, and developer tooling, I spend my days solving complex problems at scale.

About This Blog

This is my personal technical blog where I share real-world experiences, practical insights, and hard-earned lessons from my journey in the software industry.

Here you'll find:

  • ▶ Deep technical dives into topics I work with
  • ▶ Solutions to problems I've encountered in production
  • ▶ Best practices and productivity tips
  • ▶ Interesting findings from open source projects

My goal is simple: to document what I've learned so that others (including my future self) can benefit from it. No fluff — just honest, practical content from the trenches.
